findings.remediation: Remove install-time side effects or document and review each lifecycle script.
findings.impact: Install-time lifecycle scripts run before the package is reviewed at runtime and inherit installer privileges.
findings.attack_vector: package.json declares preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare code that npm may execute during installation.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: passes an unvalidated dynamic destination to a network API
findings.remediation: Parse the destination, require HTTPS, and allowlist hosts and resolved IP ranges before making the request.
findings.impact: An attacker-controlled URL can make the plugin request internal services, cloud metadata, or attacker-selected hosts.
findings.attack_vector: A non-literal destination derived from request input reaches a network API without an evident allowlist guard.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
